tips: Apply to jobs even if you meet only 70% of requirements — you will grow into the rest.
Customise your resume for each role — use keywords from the job description.
A strong LinkedIn profile with a clear headline gets recruiters to reach out.
Build projects and push them to GitHub before your final year placements.
For off-campus roles, follow company career pages directly.
Practice 2–3 DSA problems daily from your 2nd year — consistency beats cramming.
Mock interviews on Pramp or Interviewing.io help you reduce anxiety before real ones.
